g.text: Different selection signals produce different sample compositions
Top: newly selected image prevalence relative to each current candidate pool; mean of 5 rounds × 10 seeds.
Middle: frozen historical post-hoc geometry reused; class names reconciled across ID orders. Bottom: saved scores only.
Classes overlap in multi-label images; rounds are dependent. These associations do not establish downstream causation.
